args.description: kung fu dragon palms: circles both arms in a flowing motion, then thrusts both palms straight forward at chest height, then back into the stance. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
